result.summary: Found 2 issues: a misspelled search placeholder and a restaurant card title truncated by its container.

issues.description: Search field placeholder is misspelled as “Restarants” instead of “Restaurants”.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: The third Fastest-near-you card title “Trattoria Piccol” is cut off inside the card, not just by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a slightly smaller type size, or give the card enough width so the full restaurant name is visible.
